fixtureCriteria.600: Render at exactly 600 × 900 CSS pixels at 100% zoom; navigation disclosure, reading order, Thai and Latin copy, and the primary action remain complete and operable.

fixtureCriteria.1200: Render at exactly 1200 × 900 CSS pixels at 100% zoom; the desktop grid, navigation budget, evidence relationship, and action hierarchy remain intact.
fixtureCriteria.1440: Render at exactly 1440 × 900 CSS pixels at 100% zoom; content respects the 760/1120/1280 CSS-pixel container limits and does not create accidental empty bands.
fixtureCriteria.1600: Render at exactly 1600 × 1000 CSS pixels at 100% zoom; wide composition preserves the same reading path and does not stretch text beyond the governed reading measure.
fixtureCriteria.intermediate-stress: Render at exactly 713 × 823 CSS pixels with the governed longest Thai and English navigation, heading, and CTA strings; no wrap, truncation, overlap, orphan, or hidden destination changes meaning.

fixtureCriteria.360: Render the browser application at exactly 360 × 800 CSS pixels; navigation, task state, permission state, and the primary action remain operable with targets at least 44 × 44 CSS pixels.
fixtureCriteria.600: Render the browser application at exactly 600 × 900 CSS pixels; panels and disclosures preserve focus order, labels, results, and recovery without clipping.
fixtureCriteria.900: Render the browser application at exactly 900 × 900 CSS pixels; the intermediate state layout preserves task causality without overlap or an ungoverned breakpoint jump.
fixtureCriteria.1200: Render the browser application at exactly 1200 × 900 CSS pixels; product navigation, task workspace, evidence, and result regions remain distinct and operable.
fixtureCriteria.1440: Render the browser application at exactly 1440 × 900 CSS pixels; the governed grid and reading measures hold through loading, success, empty, partial, stale, permission, and error states.
fixtureCriteria.1600: Render the browser application at exactly 1600 × 1000 CSS pixels; wide layout preserves task focus and does not separate controls from their status or result.
fixtureCriteria.intermediate-stress: Render at exactly 713 × 823 CSS pixels with the governed longest Thai and English task, navigation, error, and recovery strings; no control label or state meaning truncates.

profiles.safeArea: platform window plus declared system-bar, cutout, and gesture safe-area insets

fixtureCriteria.compact-360: Render in a native window exactly 360 × 800 platform dp with declared system insets; task navigation, state, and primary action remain visible and directly operable.
fixtureCriteria.regular-768: Render in a native window exactly 768 × 1024 platform dp; reading order, pane relationship, focus traversal, and state recovery remain coherent.
fixtureCriteria.expanded-1280: Render in a native window exactly 1280 × 900 platform dp; expanded panes do not detach controls from evidence, status, result, or recovery.
fixtureCriteria.dynamic-type-200: Render with platform text scaling set to exactly 200%; all content and controls recompose without clipped Thai or Latin text, overlap, or loss of the primary task.
fixtureCriteria.safe-area-interruption: Render with maximum declared system-bar/cutout insets, then background and restore the task once; focus, input, permission, progress, and recovery state remain truthful.

fixtureCriteria.native-structure: Inspect the editable document and confirm every used title, heading, paragraph, list, table, caption, note, language, and link role is native rather than simulated by spacing or appearance.
fixtureCriteria.thai-latin-stress: Lay out the governed longest Thai and English title, three heading levels, body paragraph, table cell, caption, note, and link strings at every used style; no collision, clipping, tofu, or unintended substitution is permitted.
fixtureCriteria.short: Produce an exact two-page A4 portrait document containing title, two heading levels, one table, one figure/caption, one note, and one CTA link; no stranded heading, accidental blank page, or broken reference is permitted.
fixtureCriteria.long: Produce an exact twenty-four-page A4 portrait document containing at least six top-level sections, a generated TOC, two tables, two figures, notes, cross-references, and a source appendix; pagination and every generated reference remain correct.
fixtureCriteria.pdf-export: Export the exact long fixture to PDF with identical section order, wording, links, alternatives, evidence cues, page identity, and material limitations.

fixtureCriteria.all-pages-render: Render every delivered PDF page at 100% and 200% scale and inspect the complete montage; no page may be blank, clipped, substituted, duplicated, or missing.
fixtureCriteria.tags-order: Inspect the final PDF tag tree and reading order for every page; title, headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, figures, notes, and links follow the visible sequence without orphaned or duplicate meaningful content.
fixtureCriteria.thai-latin-stress: Extract and render the governed Thai and English stress corpus from final PDF bytes; glyphs remain selectable, correctly ordered, and free of tofu or unintended font substitution.
fixtureCriteria.links-bookmarks: Resolve every link and bookmark in the final PDF; labels are descriptive, bookmark order equals the heading hierarchy, and no destination is missing or redirected unexpectedly.
fixtureCriteria.print: Print-render every page on A4 at 100% scale in color and grayscale simulation; margins, text, graphics, evidence cues, and destinations remain legible and unclipped.

fixtureCriteria.montage: Render every slide in order as a complete 5-column montage with each thumbnail exactly 320 × 180 pixels; section transitions, repetition, density, and one-primary-idea sequencing remain legible.
fixtureCriteria.room-distance: Review the 1920 × 1080 deck on a 65-inch 16:9 display from exactly 5 metres; every primary idea, label, evidence cue, and action remains readable without presenter explanation.
fixtureCriteria.thai-latin-stress: Apply the governed longest Thai and English title, section, body, source, and action strings to every used layout; no overflow, collision, tofu, or unintended substitution is permitted.
fixtureCriteria.overflow: Populate every used layout to its declared maximum text, media, chart, map, source, and action capacity; all content remains inside the 60/80-pixel safe area with no auto-shrink below the governed minima.
fixtureCriteria.pdf-export: Export the complete deck to static PDF and verify identical slide order, primary meaning, source cues, alternatives, working links, and material limitations without relying on animation or speaker notes.

fixtureCriteria.feed-size: Downsample the exact 1080 × 1080 final creative to 270 × 270 CSS pixels and review at 100% display scale; message, identity, evidence cue, and destination cue remain readable.
fixtureCriteria.center-crop: Crop the exact final creative to the centered 864 × 864 pixel region; the complete approved message, identity, evidence cue, and destination cue remain present and unambiguous.
fixtureCriteria.safe-area: Overlay an 80-pixel exclusion band on all four edges of the 1080 × 1080 final creative; no essential message, identity, evidence cue, or destination cue intersects the band.
fixtureCriteria.thai-latin-stress: Render the governed longest Thai and English headline, source, limitation, and destination strings within the final square; no clipping, collision, tofu, or unintended substitution is permitted.
fixtureCriteria.destination-cue: At both 1080 × 1080 and 270 × 270, exactly one truthful destination cue is readable and visually non-interactive; it matches the bound primary CTA destination and does not imitate a button.

fixtureCriteria.text-safe-area: Overlay the 1000 × 560 text-safe region centered on the creative; every text element lies inside it.
fixtureCriteria.central-square-crop: Crop the exact final creative to the centered 630 × 630 square; the symbol or lockup and the first title line remain complete and unambiguous.
fixtureCriteria.two-to-one-crop: Crop the exact final creative to a centered 1200 × 600 region; message, identity, evidence cue, and destination cue remain present.

fixtureCriteria.recognisers: The 8px four-colour rule spans the top edge, a Brand Blue panel or one declared atmosphere recipe is present, the 3 × 5px measure line is present, and the identity is at most 56px tall; no motif or animated variant is used.
